transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical faults, my name is Craig. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Craig, my name is Liam Davies. My mobile phone has started throwing an intermittent 'No SIM Card Inserted' error four or five times a day, dropping active phone calls abruptly and losing 5G connectivity!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Liam. I can test your SIM card network authentication and provisioning profile. Before we run the diagnostic tests, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 14 Priory Way, Harrogate, HG1 2PQ, and my security PIN is 5502. My mobile number is 07700 900381 and my handset is an iPhone 14 Pro.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Liam, that confirms your account details. When the 'No SIM' message displays, does rebooting the phone immediately restore cellular connection?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sometimes restarting fixes it for twenty minutes, but yesterday it stayed disconnected for two hours until I physically removed and reinserted the SIM tray!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query our Home Location Register and perform an over-the-air SIM refresh on your line?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Liam. The network registers confirm seventeen sudden radio link tear-downs over the past forty-eight hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Has the over-the-air refresh resolved whatever was causing the SIM authentication failures?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Over-the-air updates re-flash the network operator bundle, but intermittent card disconnects often originate from mechanical tray wear.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The phone has never been dropped or exposed to water. The gold contacts look spotless.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well if you constantly drop your phone or carry it loose in pockets with metal keys, no SIM tray in the world is going to maintain contact spring tension.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I keep my phone in a leather folio case and treat it with total care! Why are you accusing me of abusing my phone?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am stating the standard physical causes of intermittent contact separation on micro-SIM chipsets.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you just ship me a replacement 5G SIM card so I can verify whether the plastic card itself is faulty?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Replacement SIM dispatch requires tier-two supervisor authorization if the line was activated within twelve months.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then connect me to a tier-two supervisor who can approve a five-pound replacement card!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Supervisors are currently occupied handling billing escalations. You can visit a high-street retail store and purchase a SIM swap kit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The nearest S-Net store is twenty-five miles away in central Leeds! I am not driving fifty miles for a replacement SIM!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously physical SIM cards rely on mechanical spring tension against gold contact pads.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I know how a SIM card works! What I need is a working mobile connection for my work!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Craig, I use this mobile phone for on-call veterinary emergency dispatches! If an animal is in critical distress and my phone drops the call with 'No SIM Card', an animal could die! I cannot have an unreliable SIM card dropping my calls constantly!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how critical and urgent on-call veterinary emergencies are, Liam. Having your phone drop calls with a SIM error in the middle of an emergency dispatch is unacceptable, so let us diagnose the SIM profile immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you check if my handset can be converted to an electronic eSIM instead?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your iPhone 14 Pro supports dual active eSIM profiles with digital QR activation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can we activate an eSIM profile right now over the phone so I don't have to worry about the physical card?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can generate an eSIM activation QR voucher and email it to your verified account address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would be fantastic. Please generate that digital eSIM profile immediately.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The system requires an identity one-time passcode verification before sending electronic SIM vouchers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have my tablet ready to receive the one-time passcode via email.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have dispatched the six-digit verification code to your registered email address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Checking email on my tablet... Got it, the verification code is 881-402.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Passcode verified. Generating eSIM digital voucher reference ESIM-99210-L.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How quickly will the email arrive with the QR code?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: eSIM activation emails typically arrive within three to five minutes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: While we wait for the email, what steps do I need to follow in the iPhone Settings menu?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Open Settings, select 'Mobile Service', tap 'Add eSIM', and select 'Use QR Code'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then I simply scan the QR code from my computer screen or tablet?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct, scanning the QR code downloads the encrypted S-Net cryptographic profile directly to the secure enclave.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And once the eSIM activates, does the physical SIM card get automatically disabled?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the physical SIM becomes deactivated immediately upon digital provisioning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Checking my inbox... Yes, the email from S-Net provisioning just came through with the QR code!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to ensure the replacement SIM order goes to the right device profile, what mobile handset model are you using again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Like I said earlier, it is an iPhone 14 Pro.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Point your iPhone camera at the QR code on your tablet display to initiate profile download.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Scanning QR code now... 'Activating S-Net eSIM'... It says 'Connected - S-Net 5G' with full signal bars!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Place a test outbound call to our automated line test number on 17070 to verify voice bearer audio.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dialing 17070... Automated voice says 'Call test completed successfully'. Voice and data are working perfectly!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can now safely eject and discard the faulty plastic physical SIM card.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am removing the plastic SIM right now. Tray back in, and 5G signal remains rock solid. Thank you for sorting the eSIM, Craig.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have logged the SIM swap under technical ticket reference MOB-77192-D.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: MOB-77192-D, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other mobile query I can assist you with today, Liam?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, the eSIM has completely resolved the problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net mobile services, Liam. Have a pleasant day. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Craig.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
